description: Create an envelope from a template. Optionally pre-fill field values and send immediately. The template's fields will be mapped to the provided recipients.

prefill_fields.description: Map of field label or template_field UUID to pre-fill value (optional)

recipients.description: List of recipients for the envelope

send_immediately.description: Send the envelope immediately after creation (default: false)

template_id.description: The UUID of the template to use

title.description: Custom title for the envelope (defaults to template title)

name: create_from_template
